actions.action: List models, policies, workflows, objectives, or cases
actions.agent_and_human_interface: python3 -m routing_lab resource list KIND [--suite SUITE] [--allow-confirmation]
actions.approval: none for normal resources; confirmation case access requires --allow-confirmation

actions.action: Read a model, policy, workflow, objective, or case
actions.agent_and_human_interface: python3 -m routing_lab resource get KIND ID [--suite SUITE] [--allow-confirmation]
actions.approval: none for normal resources; confirmation case access requires --allow-confirmation

actions.action: Create a model, policy, workflow, objective, or development case
actions.agent_and_human_interface: python3 -m routing_lab resource put KIND FILE [--suite SUITE]
actions.approval: none for inactive local definitions; active policy/objective mutation uses proposals and confirmation mutation needs an explicit flag

actions.action: Update a model, policy, workflow, objective, or development case
actions.agent_and_human_interface: python3 -m routing_lab resource put KIND FILE [--suite SUITE]
actions.approval: none for inactive local definitions; active policy/objective mutation uses proposals and confirmation mutation needs an explicit flag

actions.action: Delete a model, policy, workflow, objective, or case
actions.agent_and_human_interface: python3 -m routing_lab resource delete KIND ID --yes [--suite SUITE]
actions.approval: explicit confirmation flag; active policy/objective deletion is blocked and confirmation suite needs explicit authorization

actions.action: Route one model or agent call
Route all stages of an agentic workflow
actions.agent_and_human_interface: python3 -m routing_lab workflow ID --input FILE [--policy ID]
python3 -m routing_lab evaluate --policy ID --objective ID --suite SUITE
python3 -m routing_lab optimize --base-policy ID --objective ID --suite development
actions.approval: none; creates a proposal and cannot access confirmation

actions.action: Apply an optimizer proposal to local simulation state
actions.agent_and_human_interface: python3 -m routing_lab proposal apply ID --approved-by HUMAN
actions.approval: named human; does not authorize confirmation, scientific, online, or production use

parity_rule: The CLI is the shared human and agent control surface; no hidden UI-only action exists.
